headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 876 points as IT and banking stocks dragged the market; closed today for Dussehra.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: Private banks and IT stocks led a sharp decline in the previous session
Investors lost approximately Rs 5 lakh crore in a single day during the crash
Major stocks like Infosys and Tata Motors PV saw significant selling pressure
Nifty 50 failed to hold the 22,900 level during Monday's market slump
whatHappening: Indian stock exchanges BSE and NSE are closed today for the Dussehra holiday
Reliance is discussing Venezuelan crude refining with the U.S. to diversify energy supplies
OYO-parent PRISM is reportedly planning to halve its IPO fresh issue size to Rs 3,350 crore
Artha Bharat is moving two GIFT City funds to Abu Dhabi citing tax hurdles
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Dussehra; in the last session, Sensex crashed 876 points amid heavy selling in IT and banking sectors. Reliance remains in focus following reports of US-Venezuela crude refining talks, while OYO-parent PRISM plans to reduce its IPO size. Investors lost nearly Rs 5 lakh crore on Monday as Nifty slipped below the 22,900 mark.
